g.text: adc_sarlogic_slice (Steps k = 1..13): Self-Timed SAR Bit Slice with Parameterized DAC Settling Wait
1. Token SR Latch (XTOK_*) arms en_k=1 when GO_IN=1 and comparator is reset (IDLE_B=1); XREQ pulls REQ_B=0 to request CLKC=1.
2. Decision SR Latches (XUP_*, XDN_*) cross-lock via up_b/dn_b so UP and DN are strictly mutually exclusive (LOG-11 = 0).
3. Completion NAND XDONE triggers 4-stage gatecap-loaded delay chain (XD1..XD4 + XC0..XC3, sized by wn_c/wp_c) -> GO_OUT.
UP Decision Latch & CDAC Driver (CMPP=1 -> UP=1, Q=1)
DN Decision Latch & CDAC Driver (CMPN=1 -> DN=1, Q=0)
Completion Detector & 4-Stage Parameterized DAC Settling Delay (wn_c / wp_c)
Per-Slice DAC Settling Load Schedule (wn_c / wp_c)
